title: `COVAR_*`: Welford co-moment, Chan merge
description: `ck += dx * (y - newYAvg)`; partial states merge as `ck.l + ck.r + dx * dyN * n1 * n2`. No pairs is NULL; the sample covariance of one pair is NULL (NaN under `spark.sql.legacy.statisticalAggregate`).

The probes: one pair gives NULL for `covar_samp` and 0.0 for `covar_pop` (NaN for `covar_samp` with `spark.sql.legacy.statisticalAggregate`); a constant side 0.0; `BIGINT` and decimal inputs are cast to `DOUBLE`.
Probed: `COVAR_SAMP(x, 2x)` 60 and `COVAR_POP` 45 for {4, 7, 13, 16} shifted by up to 1e12.
reference: `AggFn.cov` (`covOf`) is two-pass: the two means, then the products of the deviations added in list order from +0.0, by n or n - 1. No pairs is NULL, and so is a sample of one pair. Engines may differ in the last bits (#54) until #85 bounds the error.
